title: Run an adaptive screening design
frozenQuestion: Can a balanced fractional/sequential screen identify the dominant executable main and two-factor interaction mechanisms, with useful uncertainty, without executing the full S08 screening Cartesian product?

classificationConstraints.E02-S01-E02: executable exact-parity engineering gate; any mismatch stops S10 for review
classificationConstraints.E02-S01-E05: executable and fully accounted, but retry exposure is frozen inactive because actionFailure=none; it is excluded from sparse scientific ranking
classificationConstraints.E02-S01-E07: unpaired non-executable because the S02 information boundary is preserved; no run is assigned

fractionalDesign.unit: one S08 pairing block shared by all executable estimands
fractionalDesign.selectionRule: Within every scale and look, allocate one slot to every value-profile-by-order cell and one additional slot to a deterministically rotated cell. Independently balanced fault-profile and policy-by-direction label lists are deterministically permuted, then the lowest outcome-blind SHA-256-ranked eligible input is selected for each slot.
fractionalDesign.armRule: Execute all 14 distinct settings signatures represented by the 30 executable S08 catalog arms on every selected block. Reuse a run only when settings bytes and pairing block are identical; retain every estimand-arm mapping in a normalized contrast map.
fractionalDesign.notFullCartesianReason: The screen samples 250 of 67,500 available screening pairing blocks while retaining complete treatment support and all planned scales and structures.

outcomes.normalizedResidualError: final strict adjacent inversion count divided by max(n-1,1), lower is better
outcomes.successByBudget: 1 only for complete; lawful quiescence and event_budget are 0
outcomes.completionTime: charged opportunities; event_budget right-censored and quiescence a competing failure
outcomes.unitWeightFullCost: S09 s01UnitWeightFullCost; wall time and scheduler implementation overhead excluded
outcomes.costLedgerVector: all S09 named fields and projections retained

estimandOrientation.twoArm: active minus reference for additive task endpoints; log((active+0.5)/(reference+0.5)) for completion-opportunity and cost screening ratios
estimandOrientation.factorial: active_active - active_reference - reference_active + reference_reference for additive endpoints; the analogous signed contrast of log(value+0.5) for ratio endpoints

adaptationRules.continueRule: Continue to the next nested look unless the global precision-and-stability stop is met or the exact-parity/escalation gate fails.
adaptationRules.precisionAndStabilityStop: At a look of at least 150, stop only if the frozen S11 selection is identical at two consecutive looks, Spearman correlation of nondegenerate estimand utility ranks is at least 0.95, every selected or selection-boundary estimand has residual-error and success 95% bootstrap half-width at most 0.02, and its completion-time and full-cost log-ratio half-width is at most log(1.10).
adaptationRules.maximumRule: Stop after the 250-block look regardless of precision and label remaining uncertainty explicitly.
adaptationRules.runtimeRule: Runtime alone is not an adaptation criterion. A scientifically material execution reduction requires review rather than silent pruning.

uncertainty.bootstrapSeedRule: SHA-256 counter-addressed by S10 design hash, look, endpoint, estimand, replicate, and scale

escalationTriggers: any change to S02-S09 information, legal-action, scheduler, fault, replay, RNG, pairing, marginal-treatment, opportunity, or accounting contracts
any need to drop a planned scale, value profile, order structure, treatment signature, or nested sample increment for runtime
any administrative failure that prevents complete intention-to-simulate run accounting
